title: Retrospective clinical and genetic analysis of Best disease and autosomal recessive BEST1 retinopathy: relationships between genotype, phenotype, and disease course
summary: BEST1-associated retinopathies are a group of rare retinal diseases. Despite clinical advances in diagnostics, the relationships between specific mutations, clinical courses, and prognosis are not yet fully understood. Using existing data from the Bonn outpatient clinic, a retrospective analysis will be conducted to examine the clinical course and care situation of patients with BEST1-associated retinopathy.

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of all patients who presented at the University Eye Clinic in Bonn between 2008 and 2024 with molecularly confirmed BEST1 retinopathy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
A BEST1 mutation confirmed by molecular genetic analysis and a corresponding plausible phenotype
Exclusion criteria:
Absence of a molecularly confirmed BEST1 mutation
